execute_frontdoor.purpose: Dedicated loopback-only protocol proxy for the sealed EXECUTE lane only. The shared relay on 10101 is left unchanged (other roles use it); no global relay model blacklist.
execute_frontdoor.route_semantics: Exact raw-path/method allowlist; any other method/path or any nonempty POST query is a typed 403 before the body is read. message.content that merely mentions deepseek-flash is ordinary text and is allowed (model-routing policy, not censorship).
execute_frontdoor.health: GET /healthz returns the sanctioned provider/model and the upstream URL (no secrets); the launcher asserts provider+model+upstream and the script digest (ERR_EXEC_FRONTDOOR_HEALTH_* / ERR_EXEC_FRONTDOOR_SCRIPT_MISSING) before any Codex spawn.
execute_frontdoor.residual_risk: LOCAL_RUNTIME_CONTROL_NOT_OS_BOUNDARY - raw http://127.0.0.1:10101 remains directly reachable and is explicitly out of scope; the front door does not sandbox the OS or block a caller who bypasses the launcher.
execute_frontdoor.enforcement_honesty: The front door enforces the model FIELD (top-level model authoritative; nested request.model/response.model also checked). It is not a byte-level content filter.

model_routing_change.note: Primary Codex-lane route is now opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash. Fallbacks are retained as fail-closed safety only; they never override the primary.

opencode_go_session_header.why: opencode-go rejects any request without it (HTTP 400 MissingSessionID) on both /chat/completions and /responses. Verified: identical request without the header -> 400; with a stable session id -> 200.
opencode_go_session_header.upstream_doc: https://opencode.ai/docs/go/ - 'Codex ... Some versions and proxy setups still omit it; preserve the session header when forwarding requests.'
opencode_go_session_header.discovered_by: this run (direct provider probe: 400 without header, 200 with header, real deepseek-v4.1-flash completion)

relay_service_note: The isolated opencodex relay must be running for the Codex lane to work: `ocx start --port 10101` (or install it as a service with `ocx service install`). Relay state lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\HG-KSEOS\opencodex-hermes; the human C:\Users\user\.codex home is not used by this lane.

execute_route_contract.dispatch_path: scripts/start-hgk-hermes.ps1 -Action Write (sealed lane) - the ONLY sanctioned Codex dispatch
execute_route_contract.chain_must_be_pinned: invoke with -ModelChain deepseek-v4.1-flash so the chain cannot advance to another model; assert write_model_used in the receipt
execute_route_contract.hermes_side: model.codex_bin is set in the canonical Hermes config so every codex spawn uses this pinned, hash-verified binary. model.openai_runtime is deliberately NOT set: it is a no-op for provider=opencode-go and would break SoD if the provider were switched to openai-codex (finding F8).
execute_route_contract.precondition: CODEX_HOME must be the isolated lane home at launch; only this launcher may set it (user/machine-level CODEX_HOME is refused).
execute_route_contract.relay_dependency: http://127.0.0.1:10101/v1 must be healthy; start it with -Action StartOpenCodex (a -Action Probe stops its own relay in finally).

child_model_enforcement.enforcement_status: UNPROVEN_AS_ENFORCEMENT - finding F7: de-listed models were still served on the relay's direct completion path (opencode-go/glm-5.2 returned 200 after de-listing). The chain pin above is the compensating control.

model_fallbacks_rationale: Kept as the single sanctioned lane model. The launcher defers to binding.model + model_fallbacks when -ModelChain is omitted, so a stale two-model list is a live escape hatch (F4).
execute_fallbacks_out_of_lane_reason: Historical Hermes-side fallback declarations are preserved separately. The primary relay still exposes only opencode-go. The new execute_additional_routes entry permits explicit Codex-native OAuth routing of gpt-6-luna, not relay routing or automatic fallback; bounded-writer admission and backend usability remain unproven.

far_exec_identity_002.preserved_out_of_lane_fallbacks: execute_fallbacks_out_of_lane above is preserved verbatim; this case covers SEALED CODEX EXECUTE only and does not modify those declarations.
far_exec_identity_002.health_check: launcher verifies http://127.0.0.1:10100/healthz (provider+model+upstream+status) and the front-door script SHA256 before spawn.
